codeReview.summary: Secret manager implementation is solid and meets all requirements. Base64 encoding for keys, owner references to Job, and volume-based mounting (not env vars) are correctly implemented. Security design prevents key exposure in pod logs. 30 test cases provide good coverage. One minor code quality issue (duplicate condition in IsKeyExposedInData) but not blocking.

issues.description: Duplicate condition: 'sk-' pattern is checked twice in IsKeyExposedInData(). Lines 209 and 213 both check for 'sk-', with the second check intended for Qwen but redundant since 'sk-' is already caught in line 209.
